<title level="1" right="Class Feature 13">[Complete Reconfiguration](/Classes.aspx?ID=19)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 15

**Class** Inventor
</column>

---

When it comes to crafting and tinkering, you've become incredibly adept at changing your modifications to adjust your [innovation's](Innovations.aspx) functionality. When you spend downtime to reconfigure your innovation and succeed at your [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) check, you can swap any number of modifications, swap your offensive boost, or retrain any number of [modification](/Traits.aspx?ID=410) feats, rather than one. You still must swap a modification only with one of the same type (initial, breakthrough, or revolutionary).
name: Complete Reconfiguration
